# Transactions Requirements Checklist: Transactions (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 008 — offline-first ledger writes, the balance a person sees, transfers on two wallets, clash/restore choices, local search and filters, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): money and offline/sync correctness, transfers and permissions, contract fidelity; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec in the same session; each says where. Unchecked items were reviewed and hold; they stay open for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified what happens to the category and destination when the person switches the kind in the editor? [Gap → fixed: FR-002 "Switching the kind clears what no longer applies"]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified what happens to the typed amount and the destination when the person switches wallet before saving? [Gap → fixed: FR-008 "switching keeps the typed amount and re-checks it…"]
- [x] CHK003 Is the visibility of a wallet's transactions defined while that wallet's own deletion waits to sync? [Gap → fixed: FR-031 second sentence]
- [x] CHK004 Is the outcome defined when "Restore with my change" restores the transaction but the person's values are then refused? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases "Restore with my change whose second step…"]
- [ ] CHK005 Are loading, empty, no-match, offline and refresh-failed states of the transactions screen each specified and distinguishable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, US2-S6, US2-S7, US5-S3]
- [ ] CHK006 Is every refusal reason enumerated with the actions offered for it (edit, try again, discard)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK007 Are all three hooks C4/C5 left (balances, currency lock, category uses, wallet removal) given requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029–FR-031]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the sign-out wipe specified for every piece of transaction data the phone keeps, the last-used wallet included? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032, research R-14]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is the search field's length behaviour (more than 100 characters typed, blank search) defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-027]
- [x] CHK010 Is "can delete a transfer" defined precisely when the person can write to only one of its wallets? [Ambiguity → fixed: FR-013 rewritten]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "the effect of a change on a balance" defined for each kind and for both sides of a transfer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-017, research R-09]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "until a read of the wallet's balance that started after the server confirmed the change" unambiguous about which read counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the day total's sign rule stated for transfers in and out of the viewed wallet? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the text limits defined in the same unit the server counts (code points after trimming)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "today" defined with its time zone source? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, P-05]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Do US1-S7 and the navigation contract agree on where "create a wallet first" is shown? [Conflict → fixed: US1-S7 now says the editor shows it]
- [ ] CHK017 Do US4-S6, FR-013 and FR-021 agree on when a transfer is editable, deletable or read-only? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK018 Do FR-007 and US3-S2 agree with C5 FR-018 (current category kept whatever its state)? [Consistency, spec 007]
- [ ] CHK019 Do FR-024 ("Restore with my change") and the engine's `canRestore` contract agree? [Consistency, spec 004 contract]
- [ ] CHK020 Do the filters' combining rules (FR-028) match the backend's "repeated filters combine" rule? [Consistency, transactions.yaml]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Can SC-004 ("never shows an intermediate value") be verified objectively by a test over the send/refresh sequence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §4 invariants]
- [ ] CHK022 Are SC-001 (10 s entry) and SC-005 (1 s / 300 ms at 2,000 rows) stated with conditions a host test or a stopwatch can check? [Measurability]
- [ ] CHK023 Does every acceptance scenario map to a test layer or a planned flow in §8 and the E2E contract? [Traceability, Spec §8, contracts/ui-and-e2e.md]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are alternate entry paths (Home vs wallet) both covered by scenarios? [Coverage, US1-S1, US1-S7]
- [ ] CHK025 Are exception flows covered for each server refusal class (verification, permission, not found, category, currency, field)? [Coverage, US3-S9, US4-S4, US4-S5]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery flows (discard, try again, restore, keep the transaction) covered? [Coverage, US3-S6–S9]
- [ ] CHK027 Are viewer-role scenarios covered for the list and the detail? [Coverage, US1-S9, US3-S10]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are amount boundaries (zero, maximum, fraction digits per currency) defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK029 Are date boundaries (1900–2999, future dates) defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK030 Is behaviour defined for an unknown kind from a newer server? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Is behaviour defined for a wallet's currency changing before the first transaction syncs? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK032 Is behaviour defined for transfers whose other wallet was deleted or is not on the phone? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013, US4-S6]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 Are logging/privacy rules stated for amounts, notes and payloads? [Security, Spec §FR-036, P-09]
- [ ] CHK034 Are accessibility requirements stated for direction (money in/out) beyond colour? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK035 Are Western digits required in the date picker in Arabic? [Localisation, Spec §FR-004, research R-16]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Is the backend commit and the frozen `transactions.yaml` version recorded, with contract changes since spec 007 each mapped to an FR or a follow-up? [Dependency, Spec §5]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the archived-wallet and archived-destination choices recorded as client decisions that differ from what the backend accepts? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Clarification 5]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the wave-1 full-list read documented as temporary with its replacement named (C14 wave 2)? [Assumption, Spec §5, §9]
